heading: Careers
intro: Booth rentals available — contact for more info!
body: Empyrean Beauty is always interested in talking with stylists and barbers who take their craft seriously. We keep a small, senior room: sustainable product, professional tools, and guests who book ahead. If you hold a current Texas license and want a chair in a studio that lets you build your own book, we'd like to meet you.

openings.title: Booth Rental — Stylist
openings.description: A full station in the salon side of the studio. Set your own hours and pricing, keep your own clientele, and work alongside a team that shares your standards.

openings.title: Booth Rental — Barber
openings.description: A dedicated barber chair for cuts, beard work and shaves. Ideal for a licensed barber with an established following looking for a professional home.

cta.heading: Interested?
cta.body: Send us a note and Kayla will get back to you personally.
